thesis: EXEL is a high-quality, profitable biotech in a strong uptrend that has held up while NASDAQ growth sold off, and the regime itself shows money rotating toward health care. The Oct 30 post-earnings volume surge reads as accumulation, and short interest above 15% of float adds fuel if the stock resumes upward. The case is only for a pullback entry in the 69.6-71.3 zone, not for chasing: RSI is 70.5, price is extended above SMA20, and supply showed up at 73.69. Reward/risk of 2.1 to the 76.0 target is acceptable but not wide, the news feed was unavailable, and the stock trades above the mean analyst target, so this is a modest-conviction, entry-disciplined long in a risk-off tape.
